comment: The Mode CV range is written as 0 to 0.91V because the code clamps voltage times 12 to the last of the twelve modes, which is 11/12V. The maker's manual says the Hold input is off at 0V or less and on above 5V; the code compares against 1.5V (composites/Arpeggiator.h:254), and the code is what ships. The manual also gives the Schmitt trigger threshold as 1.0V, where util/Constants.h:11 has 1.6V. Mode names in the manual differ from the ones the dropdown prints: the list is 'up then down' and 'down then up', not 'up and down' and 'down and up' (util/ArpegPlayer.h:54). Output 2 is an unused end-of-cycle output with no widget. Params 4 to 8 are hidden state and menu settings with no widget. Reset Mode II comes up on.
